dependencies.basis: SELF-DECLARED: IBGE's own Summary of Methodology submitted to the IMF DSBB states the national accounts' industry classification is ISIC Rev. 4 by name, for category NAG00 (National Accounts, Annual) — the category this node's own edge to sna-2008 (also NAG00) is already wired from, not the quarterly br-cnt. Re-fetched live 2026-09-08.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Classification of production by economic activity is based on the International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities, Rev 4 (ISIC, Rev 4).

dependencies.basis: SELF-DECLARED: INEI's own Summary of Methodology submitted to the IMF DSBB states economic-activity classification for the (annual) national accounts is ISIC Rev. 4 by name. Same category (NAG00) this node is already wired to sna-2008 from. Re-fetched live 2026-09-08.
dependencies.evidence_quote: INEI data and the 2008 edition of the International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities ISIC Rev. 4 are taken into account for the classification of economic activities.

dependencies.basis: SELF-DECLARED: BPS/Ministry of Finance's Summary of Methodology for category CGO00 (Central Government Operations) states the compilation framework follows Indonesia's own Government Statistics Manual, and states in the same sentence that THAT manual is adapted from GFSM 2014 — the document states the derivation itself, which is what the 2026-09-06 nomenclature-based-on-standard ruling (`PLAYBOOK-CORPUS.md` §7a) turns on for a national classification based on HS; extending that same reasoning here since the shape is identical (an intermediate national document the source explicitly says is adapted from the target). id-apbn (State Budget/APBN, Ministry of Finance) is the CGO00-scoped candidate: it is central-government-only, unlike id-local-government-finance (district/city) or id-government-accounts (general government, both levels, which is GGO00 below). Re-fetched live 2026-09-08.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The compilation framework of the data on the general government operations follows the Indonesian Government Statistics Manual that is adapted from IMF’s Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014.
